author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
description: Schedules a downtime, acknowledges the problem, removes existing downtimes or acknowledgements, or a combination of these for services whose name and summary match configured regular expressions. Two ways to run it, both configured with the same rules: as active check, which queries all services of a site via the REST API on every check interval (automation secret from the password store), or as notification plugin (action handler in a notification rule), which acts on the notified service via Livestatus right when the problem notification is created. All matching rules apply, the first one wins per action. Downtime duration, acknowledgement options (sticky, persistent, notification, expiry) and comment filters for the downtimes and acknowledgements to remove are configurable per rule.
name: auto_downtime
title: Automatic downtime and acknowledgement by plugin output
